sourceScope: 1952 economic coordination treaty and constitutional promulgation chronology

evidence.claim: 1952-05-24 economic agreement signed by Paek and Meyer, not Rhee
Paek says cabinet approved amended draft; no direct Rhee instruction shown
1952-07-07 Rhee promulgated amendment with Chang countersignature; Article32 direct election of both chambers
1952-07-08 Rhee directed presidential-centered operation of revised constitution

contradictions.description: National Archives curator dates 55th cabinet 7/4 09:30 while vote was 7/4 night; originals needed
NAA curator appears to carry May draft one-third appointed senators into July promulgation analysis, despite Article32 direct election

guardrail: Rhee presidential tenure does not imply individual direction of Paek-Meyer treaty negotiations, bank disbursements, or CEB implementation.
